MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The hardware and repair supplies loosely connect to my recent screws, nails, and drywall anchors, but none meets a clear need I would act on now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts and metal-cutting wheels serve different jobs from my recent wood screws and framing nails; I have not shown a need for bolted connections or metal cutting.",
    "Calipers, infrared thermometers, and heat shrink tubing require measurement or wiring tasks that my recent purchases do not suggest.",
    "Adhesives would make sense only with a specific bonding repair in mind, and eighteen rolls of tape or twelve tubes of glue exceed any need I have expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying fastening supplies seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply, although the particular job matters to me.",
    "My larger packs of nails and screws seem to have been treated as a general preference for bulk supplies, when quantity depends on what I am using them for."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail and screw purchases point toward specific fastening needs where dimensions, material, and tool compatibility matter.",
    "My latest vacuum-bag purchase names particular compatible vacuum types, making replacement fit a stronger connection than general repair usefulness.",
    "I choose supplies when they match an immediate task; occasional household purchases do not mean I want to stock up on unrelated tools and consumables."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize a broad hardware and maintenance interest but miss the specific tasks, compatibility, and quantities that would make me choose an item now."
}
